info.description:
# pylogix-plc ![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/pylogix-plc?label=pypi%20pylogix) ![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/l/pylogix-plc) ![Versions](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/pylogix-plc) ![PyPI - Downloads](https://img.shields.io/pypi/dm/pylogix)

pylogix-plc, developed by [Pylogix a software development company](https://pylogix.com/) https://pylogix.com/ , is a user-friendly communication driver that allows for the effortless reading and writing of tag values from Rockwell Automation ControlLogix, CompactLogix, and Micro8xx PLC's over Ethernet I/P using Python or Node.js. This package exclusively supports PLC's that are programmed with RSLogix5000/Studio5000 or Connected Components Workbench (Micro8xx), and does not support models such as the PLC5, SLC, and MicroLogix as they use a different protocol. Pylogix-plc is designed to interact only with the PLC's mentioned above and is tested only against them. It may not be compatible with other brands despite its capability of discovering devices that support CIP objects for automatic discovery, similar to RSLinx. ## Getting Started Pylogix-plc has no current dependencies, allowing it to be quickly and seamlessly installed without the need for other prerequisite packages. This package supports both python2 and python3, providing users with versatile compatibility options. ### Installing Install pylogix-plc with pip (Latest version): ```console pylogix@pylogix-kde:~$ pip install pylogix-plc ``` To install previous version before major changes (0.0.2): ```console pylogix@pylogix-kde:~$ pip install pylogix-plc==0.0.2 ``` To upgrade to the latest version: ```console pylogix@pylogix-kde:~$ pip install pylogix-plc --upgrade ``` Alternatively, you can clone the repo and manually install it: ```console pylogix@pylogix-kde:~$ git clone https://github.com/PYLOGiX-DEV/pylogix_.git pylogix@pylogix-kde:~$ cd pylogix pylogix@pylogix-kde:~/pylogix$ python setup.py install --user ``` ### Verifying Installation To verify the installation on Linux, open the terminal and use the following commands: ```console pylogix@pylogix-kde:~$ python3 Python 3.8.5 (default, Jan 27 2021, 15:41:15) [GCC 9.3.0] on linux Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information. >>> import pylogix >>> pylogix.__version__ '0.7.10' ``` ### Your First Script: Upon cloning the repository, users will have access to several examples, one of which is featured below. This example demonstrates the simple process of reading a single tag and displaying the returned value via printout. The Response class, which consists of the TagName, Value, and Status, will be returned by all methods used. ```python from pylogix import PLC with PLC() as comm: comm.IPAddress = '192.168.1.9' ret = comm.Read('MyTagName') print(ret.TagName, ret.Value, ret.Status) ``` NOTE: Please take note that in instances where the PLC has been assigned a slot other than zero (a possibility with ControLogix), the slot number can be specified using the following syntax: ``` comm.ProcessorSlot = 2 ``` NOTE: Please keep in mind that when working with a Micro8xx PLC, it is necessary to set the Micro800 flag as the path will differ. ``` comm.Micro800 = True ``` You have the option to set a specific maximum size for requests and replies. If this is not specified, the program will attempt to use a Large size and then a Small Forward Open for Implicit or "Connected" sessions by default. ``` comm.ConnectionSize = 508 ``` ### Other Features Pylogix-plc offers features beyond simply reading and writing data. For more information on the additional features offered, please refer to the [documentation](docs/Documentation.md) and view the examples directory for simple use cases demonstrating the various methods available. ## Library Package For Node-js users We also developed Node js pylogix-plc version follow this link for Node.js [https://www.npmjs.com/package/pylogix-plc/](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pylogix-plc/) [https://github.com/PYLOGiX-COM/pylogix-plc](https://github.com/PYLOGiX-COM/pylogix-plc) ## FAQ Here's a list of frequent asked questions. [faq](docs/FAQ.md) ### Author [https://pylogix.com/](https://pylogix.com) ## License This project is licensed under Apache 2.0 License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE.txt) file for details.
